title: Jev Ultrafast: a browser agent that never generates a coordinate or a selector
description:
Jev Ultrafast clicks through a webpage without generating a single coordinate or selector. Most browser agents screenshot the page, feed it to a vision model, and wait while it writes out where to click, step after step. This one reads the DOM directly, builds an indexed table of clickable elements, and makes two decisions, action and target, in one network round trip. 

https://github.com/browser-use/jev-ultrafast
